jobs.title: AI Customer Strategy Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT BROCCOLI AI

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.

 - We've grown to $15M+ ARR in under two years.

 - We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.

 - We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.




THE ROLE

We’re hiring an AI Customer Strategy Lead to get customers live on our platform and make it deliver real value in their business.

This is the work that turns a signed contract into a customer who runs their front office on our platform. You’ll own the rollout end to end: understand how each business operates, configure and launch the platform to fit it, drive adoption across the front office and technicians, and prove the impact in the customer’s own numbers. You won’t do it alone — you’ll partner closely with our forward-deployed engineers, who handle the deep technical build while you own the customer, the configuration, and the outcome. You’ll do this across a portfolio of customers at once, and you’ll help shape the playbook and delivery model that let us do it well at scale.

The best person for this has done implementation or deployment before at a company where getting customers live and adopting was the product. This is hands-on transformation work — you own the rollout and the outcome, not a set of recommendations. You understand SMB operators, you’re comfortable in the data, and you measure yourself by whether the customer is genuinely better off. It’s an early, high-ownership role with real room to grow as we scale.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the rollout. Take customers from signed to fully live on the platform — scoping, configuration, launch, and adoption across the front office, technicians, and locations.

 - Learn the business first. Understand how each customer actually operates, then set up the platform to fit the way they work.

 - Drive adoption and value. Make sure customers are using the platform deeply and getting real results — and quantify it in hard numbers (ROI, revenue, conversion, labor savings).

 - Manage a portfolio. Run multiple customer rollouts at once, keeping each on track to go-live and to value.

 - Be the customer’s trusted partner. Build the relationship, run the day-to-day, and turn frontline results into reporting their leadership trusts.

 - Partner with engineering. Work hand in hand with our forward-deployed engineers — they handle the deep technical build, you own the customer, the configuration, and the outcome.

 - Influence the playbook and delivery model. Turn what works in the field into repeatable practices that shape how we deliver the platform as we scale.

 - Feed the field back to Product. Turn what you learn on the ground into signal that shapes the roadmap and how we deliver.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4–8+ years in implementation, onboarding, deployment, or platform migration at a high-growth software or ops-heavy company (e.g., ServiceTitan, Toast, Rippling, or similar).

 - Also a fit: technology-transformation or systems-implementation consulting (e.g., Deloitte, Accenture) where you ran the rollout rather than advised, or an engineering/technical background you’ve turned toward customers and business outcomes.

 - A track record of getting customers live and adopting — ideally across a portfolio, and ideally with SMB or multi-location operators.

 - Measurable impact you can point to: adoption, retention, time-to-value, revenue, or operational improvement you drove through execution.

 - Customer obsession. You measure yourself by whether the customer is better off, and you do what it takes.

 - Comfort in the data yourself — you can pull the numbers, show the impact, and tell the story.

 - Strong presence with both senior leaders and frontline operators; you can earn a shop owner’s trust as easily as an executive’s.

 - An AI-native mindset. You use AI tools daily and have strong intuition for how AI reshapes the way a business runs.

 - Excited to work in person 5 days a week in San Francisco with the team.




BONUS POINTS

 - You’ve owned a platform migration or major product rollout across many customers or locations.

 - Experience in home services, field services, restaurants, retail, or other multi-location / SMB-dense industries.

 - Startup experience.

 

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.

ABOUT BROCCOLI AI

At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.

We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.

Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.

 - We've grown to $15M+ ARR in under two years.

 - We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.

 - We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.




THE ROLE

If you've been on the value creation side of private equity, you know the job: find the operational levers, pull them across the portfolio, and turn them into EBITDA. AI is the largest lever to come along in a generation, and Broccoli is how the trades pull it.



We're hiring AI Strategy Lead to drive AI value creation across several of our strategic PE-backed growth accounts. You'll help our CEO communicate the value creation thesis for these accounts, own the outcome of delivering against it, and shape where each customer takes AI next.



You won't do it alone. Each account comes with a dedicated team of implementation, customer success, and forward-deployed engineers driving deployments and adoption on the ground. You lead those teams and own the outcome: ensuring every account gets the most from what it has today and has a clear path to realizing additional value over time across products and locations.



Expect travel to customers as needed to build relationships and drive outcomes.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the outcome on each account: make sure every location is getting the highest value from the AI products it runs today, quantify it in hard numbers (ROI, EBITDA impact, revenue, conversion, labor savings), and turn frontline results into reporting for customer leadership.

 - Diagnose why some locations outperform and others lag, then close the gap across technology, people, and process.

 - Drive expansion into more AI products and more locations, growing each account toward our expanding platform.

 - Support our CEO on the executive relationship, owning the prep, the value story, and the day-to-day with customer leadership.

 - Direct the on-account team that owns execution (implementation, customer success, forward-deployed engineers) while you stay accountable for the outcome.

 - Feed learnings from the field back to Product, Engineering, and Operations to shape both the roadmap and our operating model.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5-8+ years across PE value creation or operating roles, strategy consulting (MBB), tech consulting (Deloitte, Accenture) or strategy & operations in trades, industrials, or field services. Significant plus for experience with tech transformations

 - A track record of measurable impact: EBITDA, margin, revenue, or operational improvement you drove through execution, not just recommended.

 - Customer obsession. You measure yourself by whether the customer is better off, and you do what it takes to make sure they are.

 - Strong executive presence. You hold your own with operators and senior leaders.

 - Comfortable in the data yourself. You can pull the numbers and build the model.

 - You build polished, executive-ready slides that make complex work easy to follow.

 - Deep operational knowledge of how roll-up businesses run, and where the leverage hides.

 - An AI-native mindset. You use AI tools daily and have strong intuition for how AI reshapes how organizations operate.

 - Excited to work in-person 5 days a week in San Francisco with the team




BONUS POINTS

 - Experience at PE portco specifically in home services  (e.g., HVAC, roofing, garage, pest control, etc.)

 - Startup experience

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.

jobs.description:

Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.

Today:

 - Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.

 - We've grown to $15M+ ARR in under two years.

 - We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.

 - We're backed by Khosla Ventures and Y Combinator.

We're still just getting started.




THE ROLE

As a Strategy & Operations Lead, you'll work across one or more of our core Strategy & Operations pillars, depending on your experience and the company's priorities. This role is designed for high-agency operators who thrive in fast-paced environments and want to work on the most important problems facing the business: from company strategy and operational excellence to customer transformation and enterprise growth.




RUNNING BROCCOLI

Business Operations

Objective: Build the operating system that helps Broccoli scale efficiently.

Responsibilities:

 - Own business performance management, KPIs, reporting, and operational reviews.

 - Build and manage key enablement tools such as QBRs, health scorecards, and product adoption dashboards.

 - Drive business enablement initiatives that improve customer and revenue outcomes.

 - Lead cross-functional operational improvements across go-to-market, customer success, and growth.



Founder's Office

Objective: Drive company strategy, planning, and executive initiatives.

Responsibilities:

 - Support strategic planning, board materials, and executive decision-making.

 - Lead high-priority company initiatives and special projects.

 - Drive alignment and execution against key company priorities.




HELPING CUSTOMERS SUCCEED

AI Transformation

Objective: Help customers adopt AI and transform how their organizations operate.

Responsibilities:

 - Advise customers on AI adoption, workflow redesign, and organizational change.

 - Develop best practices and transformation frameworks.

 - Support customers in realizing measurable value from AI.
   
   

Intelligence Platform

Objective: Provide customers with the data, insights, and benchmarks needed to drive outcomes.

Responsibilities:

 - Deliver insights, benchmarks, and reporting that help customers improve performance.

 - Measure AI adoption, business outcomes, and value creation.

 - Help shape customer-facing analytics and intelligence capabilities.




WINNING & EXPANDING STRATEGIC ACCOUNTS

Value Creation

Objective: Quantify, communicate, and maximize the business value of AI transformation.

Responsibilities:

 - Build ROI models, business cases, and value creation frameworks.

 - Support enterprise sales and strategic customer conversations.

 - Partner with private equity firms and portfolio companies on AI transformation opportunities.



What We're Looking For

 - 5+ years in strategy consulting (McKinsey, Bain, or BCG), tech consulting (Deloitte, Accenture) or comparable experience; significant plus for experience with tech transformations

 - Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving

 - High-ownership mindset with a bias toward action and execution

 - Exceptional customer communication skills

 - Excited to work in-person five days per week with the team in San Francisco.

Bonus

 - 1–2+ years of experience at a high-growth startup.

 - Experience working in home services or B2B SaaS.

Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.

As a Strategy & Operations Manager, you'll work directly on the most important analytical problems facing the business. Broccoli is growing fast, and the number of questions that matter is growing faster: which customers are healthiest and why, where we're leaving revenue on the table, what's actually driving performance across hundreds of contractors.



This is the role for a consultant who always ended up owning the model, the analysis, and the data work on every engagement. You'll take ambiguous, high-priority questions, structure them, get into the data yourself, and drive them to an answer someone acts on.

You'll work across two of our core Strategy & Operations pillars:


Business Operations

Objective: Build the operating system that helps Broccoli scale efficiently.

 - Own strategic deep dives end to end — frame the question, build the analysis, deliver a clear recommendation to leadership.

 - Support business performance management: KPIs, reporting, and operational reviews.

 - Drive cross-functional projects with sales, customer success, and product — from sizing opportunities to changing how we operate based on what the data says.



Intelligence Platform

Objective: Provide customers with the data, insights, and benchmarks needed to drive outcomes.

 - Build the analyses behind QBRs and executive reviews for our largest customers, turning Broccoli and ServiceTitan data into narratives that change how they run their businesses.

 - Deliver insights and benchmarks that help customers improve performance.

 - Turn one-off analyses into repeatable tools — working with our analytics and engineering teams so the best insights become dashboards, templates, and product.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–6 years of experience at a top consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG, Deloitte, Accenture, or comparable) with hands-on experience working with data.

 - Passion for exploring and applying the latest AI tools and technologies to solve real business problems.

 - High-ownership mindset with a bias toward action and execution.

 - Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Excited to work in-person five days per week with the team in San Francisco.


BONUS

 - Experience at a high-growth startup.

 - Experience working in home services or B2B SaaS.

The Role

We are hiring our first Chief of Staff to operate out of the founder's office, working directly with our CEO and partnering closely across the exec team. This is a broad mandate: part strategic thought partner, part cross-functional operator, part connective tissue for a fast-moving leadership team.



What You'll Own

Strategy and Special Projects

 - Drive strategic special projects end to end, from framing the problem to seeing execution through.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous, undefined problems that don't yet have an obvious owner.

 - Act as a thought partner to the CEO on prioritization, weighing trade-offs and pressure-testing plans before they go company-wide.



Cross-Functional Execution

 - Lead cross-functional initiatives that require coordinating across engineering, GTM, finance, and people.

 - Partner with the broader exec team (CTO, COO) on initiatives that span the founder's office.

 - Track ownership and follow-through across teams so priorities don't stall between functions.



Operating Cadence

 - Own the rhythm of how leadership operates, including planning sessions, leadership meetings, all-hands prep, and priority tracking.

 - Build and improve internal operating systems and processes as the company scales past its early-stage.



Board and Executive Support

 - Prepare board and investor materials, including decks, memos, and synthesizing input from across the company into something the CEO can walk into a room with.

 - Act as a force multiplier for the CEO's time, judgment, and follow-through across a wide range of priorities.



Nice to Have 

 - Prior experience in a founder's office or chief-of-staff-adjacent role at a high-growth startup.

 - Strategy consulting experience before moving into an operating role.

 - Past founder experience.

 - Comfort picking up new internal tools quickly (we run on Ashby, Slack, and Google Workspace).



Broccoli is an equal-opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practice laws.
